# NBAPI 1.2.0

## 1.2.0

- Added a default frontend setting for the home page background image.
- The public home page now reads the background from system options and applies it to the built-in landing page and custom Markdown/HTML home pages.
- Release builds now use versioned release-note files when publishing GitHub Releases.

## Previous NBAPI updates

### 1.1.3

- Fixed Responses-to-ChatCompletions request conversion when multiple consecutive function calls appear before their outputs.
- Consecutive Responses `function_call` items are now grouped into a single ChatCompletions assistant `tool_calls` message so following tool outputs are protocol-valid.

### 1.1.2

- Normalized Responses tool-call arguments when converting through ChatCompletions.
- Kept thinking output hidden by default for the Responses fallback path.

### 1.1.1

- Improved serial Responses tool-call handling so tool outputs are paired with the correct call IDs.

### 1.1.0

- Improved the operations monitoring UI.
- Moved alert-rule editing into a compact dialog flow.
- Added Responses compact-context fallback improvements for converted requests.

### 1.0.2

- Added a gate for exposing reasoning fallback output in Responses conversion.

### 1.0.1

- Hid reasoning content by default when ChatCompletions responses are converted back to Responses.

### 1.0.0

- Added channel-level controls to force Responses requests through ChatCompletions conversion.
- Added Moonshot/Kimi Responses fallback support through the existing ChatCompletions conversion path.
